title: Mimi EP2 playful worry to warm bath day
prompt: Solo piano, light and gently playful at first like a small anxious tiptoe, around 76 BPM, soft staccato left hand and a simple curious melody in the middle register, then a bittersweet dip in the middle as feelings get hurt, then a slow warm turn into a tender major-key lullaby and a soft smiling final chord. The feeling of a family and their little dog finding each other after a funny misunderstanding. Very restrained dynamics (pianissimo to mezzo-piano), steady middle register, no sudden loud notes and no busy high-register runs, so it can sit quietly under spoken dialogue. Solo piano only: no drums, no strings, no vocals, no synth pads, no sound effects.
